A '''Kala'uun Joy Cave''' was a structure in which multiple private rooms would surround a central chamber. [[Alema Rar]] spent much time in these on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. While stalking [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] in the lower levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], they peered into a room vaguely resembling one of these "caves."
